beats.line: Once upon a time, three billy goats lived near a hill of sweet green grass. To get there, they had to cross a bridge.
But under the bridge lived a grumpy troll.
Moon side, you are the troll! Put on your shaggy cape and your big, heavy boots.
Sun side, you are the goats! Put on your horns.
The littlest goat goes first. Trip, trap, trip, trap. Sun side, tiptoe, quiet and small.
How does the troll talk? Tap Big and booming, or Squeaky and small.
Moon side, say it big and booming: Who is that tripping over my bridge?

variants.a: Moon side, say it big and booming: Who is that tripping over my bridge?
variants.b: Moon side, say it squeaky and small: Who is that tripping over my bridge?

beats.line: Sun side, be a brave little goat. Say: Wait for my big brother. He is much bigger than me!
Here comes the biggest goat. TRIP, TRAP! Sun side, stomp, big and slow.
The troll jumps up. The big goat lowers his horns. Everyone, freeze like a statue!
Bump! The big goat bumps the troll right off the bridge. Splash! Into the river he goes.
Now everyone, be the goats munching sweet grass on the hill. Munch, munch. Show me your happy face.
The end! Tap Swap and play again, and the Sun side and Moon side trade parts.
One morning, a little old woman baked a gingerbread boy. Ding! She opened the oven door.
Sun side, you are the Gingerbread Boy! Put on your icing buttons and your candy bow tie.
Out he jumped, and away he ran! Sun side, run in your seats and say: Run, run, as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the Gingerbread Boy!
Moon side, you are the little old woman and the little old man. Put on your aprons. Wave your arms and call: Stop! Stop!
Now Moon side, you are a cow in the field. Put on your bell. Say: Moo! Stop, little cookie!
How does the Gingerbread Boy run past the pig? Tap Super fast, or Slow and silly.
Moon side, you are the pig. Oink! Sun side, run past the pig super fast!

variants.a: Moon side, you are the pig. Oink! Sun side, run past the pig super fast!
variants.b: Moon side, you are the pig. Oink! Sun side, run past the pig in slow motion, slow and silly!

beats.line: Then the Gingerbread Boy came to a wide river. He could not swim! A sly fox sat on the bank.
Moon side, you are the fox. Put on your pointy ears and your bushy tail. Say it sweet and sly: Hop on my tail. I will carry you across.
Sun side, hop onto the fox's tail. Now onto his back. Now onto his nose!
Everyone, freeze! The Gingerbread Boy is on the fox's nose. Show me with your face: worried, or happy?
Snap! The clever fox gobbled him up. And that was the end of the Gingerbread Boy.
The end! Tap Swap and play again, and the Sun side and Moon side trade parts.
Grandpa planted a tiny turnip seed. He said: Grow, little turnip. Grow big and sweet!
Everyone, be the seed. Curl up small. Now grow, grow, grow, and stretch up tall!
Sun side, you are Grandpa. Put on your straw hat. Grab the leaves and pull! Heave-ho! It would not come up.
Moon side, you are Grandma. Put on your shawl. Hold on to Grandpa and pull! Heave-ho! It would not come up.
Sun side, you are the granddaughter. Put on your bow. Pull! Heave-ho! Still stuck.
Moon side, you are the dog. Woof! Pull! Heave-ho! Still stuck.
Sun side, you are the cat. Meow! Pull! Heave-ho! Still stuck.
Who should help next? Tap the Tiny mouse, or the Big bear.
Everyone, you are the tiny mouse. Put on your little ears. Squeak! Now everyone pull together. One, two, three, heave-ho!
Pop! Out came the turnip, and everyone tumbled down in a heap! Freeze in your funny heap!
And they all ate turnip soup. The end! Tap Swap and play again, and the Sun side and Moon side trade parts.
